test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.**

He maliciously (**damaged**) a car with a baseball bat.
solution: The correct answer is **"Marred."** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • **'Marred' **means to harm or damage something good. (ख़राब करना; क्षति पहुँचाना; बिगाड़ देना) • **Example**: *The celebrations were **marred**__ by the drunken fight.* • **'Damaged'** means to spoil or harm something, for example by breaking it. (हानि पहुँचाना, नुक़सान करना (जैसे कुछ तोड़ देना)) __ • **Example**: *The roof was **damaged**__ by the storm.* • Therefore, **'Marred'** is the most similar in meaning to **'damaged'** in this context. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Mended)** means to repair something that was broken or damaged. (क्षतिग्रस्‍त वस्‍तु की मरम्‍मत करना) • **Option 2 (Loaded)** means to fill something with a heavy or large quantity of something. (कोई वस्‍तु बड़ी मात्रा में किसी में भर देना या किसी पर लाद देना) • **Option 3 (Corrupted)** means to spoil or damage something morally or politically. (अनुचित अथवा अनैतिक व्यवहार के लिए प्रेरित करना; भ्रष्‍ट करना) 3a:T846, The correct answer is **"interest rates four times since last January."**
